objective: Make the tenant live-call transcript status truthful, use the configured Gemini PSTN transcription model without provider fallback, show only the amount actually charged from the wallet ledger, remove the Ctrl+K hint, and keep internal supplier-cost breakdowns out of tenant surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Configured Gemini PSTN live transcription model remains the selected transcriber; graceful teardown does not turn an already captured transcript into a false failure.
Actual provider failures remain visible as failed or partial status without the generic contact-support message when a saved transcript exists.
Calls and Billing show the wallet transaction amount for the call, in the charged currency, without supplier/model cost components or per-session rates.
Tenant call-list and last-session responses do not expose supplier-cost breakdown fields; admin cost reporting remains unchanged.
Search remains usable and its Ctrl+K/⌘K visual hint is removed.
Focused regression tests and UI verification cover the changed behavior; no live call or billing rate is altered.
non_goals: Do not change admin-configured prices or the per-minute charge formula; use the call's locked FX snapshot when a mixed-currency wallet needs its secondary balance leg.
Do not change the Gemini voice provider or make a paid production call.
Do not change secondary PSTN or OpenAI voice-stack behavior.
blast_radius: tenant call history, billing summary, and live transcript status
